about: Who-colouring misreads reported by the owner (30-31 Oct 2026), as fixtures. Wording is neutralised; the sentence structure (all the analyzer reads) is kept. Each check names a clause by a substring of it and the characters expected to act in it ([] = nobody).
script:
INT. VILLAGE SQUARE - DAY

Drums somewhere. A crowd fills the square. But the people there are so pushy, those that march among them, like a parade.

There was a group of people that marched as a parade, and they all carried the girl to the river.

EXT. RIVERBANK - DAY

A teenage indian girl of great beauty, wrapped in a blue starry robe. This is UATAKI. She is tired.

THE PROCESSION moves along the bank. Among them HEITOR (HEITOR Furtado de Mendonça), a jesuit priest in a black habit.

In turns, all attempt to touch the girl as a few carry her on a rough wooden canopy topped by a crown of furs and feathers.

The PROCESSION goes silently along the river. Many of the people are weeping. Some of them are in disbelief. All of them are in awe.

Everyone in the PROCESSION, including HEITOR, greets the girl UATAKI.

HEITOR and UATAKI liked talking all day in front of the PROCESSION folk.

And this is exactly what the girl thought while the priest was scolding her.

INT. CHAPEL - NIGHT

There is a girl called UATAKI. She is extremely pretty. But HEITOR on the other hand is ugly as sin. He is a man of few words, and she is a beauty.

And one day the girl laughed at the man so hard he got super angry but then she apologized.

So when the girl was already exhausted, all the men in the PROCESSION came around her and carried her outside again.

There was a group of people that marched as a parade, and they all carried the girl to the river.

There is never a better time to sleep than when one is tired. Some women take it better than others.

INT. FARMHOUSE - DAY

This was the day when MATHILDA was meant to meet her new husband, HORATIO, who was a good man and had a very strong voice.

She was very happy because she had never been courted by a farmer.

INT. FARMHOUSE - LATER

This was the day when MATHILDA was meant to meet her new husband, HORATIO.HORATIO was a good man, and he had a very strong voice.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

Once upon a time there were THREE LITTLE PIGS, who were really nasty. Their dream was to catch LITTLE RED HOOD. She was a nice girl, a bit timid.

So the girl called the priest. The priest came but he asked for money in exchange for his advice.

PRIEST
Nothing is free.

The girl said no.

So the THREE LITTLE PIGS came along and proposed to save the girl. But she only cared about getting out, and tried to convince the pigs to leave the priest for later.

The girl got bored and started humming to herself.

The pigs laughed. One of the pigs laughed so hard he fell over on the priest. The priest got mad and scolded the three pigs.

The priest got mad, but proposed another solution: watch while the pigs chased her.

These animals were really nasty.
